'''Daria Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and the daughter of [[Stanel Andaren Thul]].

==Biography==
{{GameDSmechanics}}
In [[3643 BBY]], Daria led an Inspection team during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] until they were captured by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. Her father, Stanel Thul, sent an imperial combatant to find the Inspection team. However, by the time the combatant reached Daria Thul, she had already become a joiner of the [[Ukanaku]] nest and introduced herself as "New-Child". She did not wish to return to her father. The Imperial however forced Daria to do so and the hive let her go over fear of retaliation.<ref name="Hive Mined" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The player is given the choice to either take Daria Thul back to her father (dark side choice) or to leave her with the hive (light side choice).<ref name="Hive Mined" />
